definitions.explanation: A state of complete physical and mental exhaustion. A four-character compound (四字熟語) that emphasizes the extreme degree of tiredness, stronger than simply 疲労 alone.

examples.japanese: {疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: I'm so exhausted I can't move.

examples.japanese: {三日間|みっかかん}⟦{寝|ね}→寝る：00470_neru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧、{疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧だった。
examples.english: After working three days without sleep, I was in a state of total exhaustion.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The runners who finished the marathon crossed the goal line smiling despite their utter exhaustion.

notes:
USAGE:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound). Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧ means fatigue; ⟦{困憊|こんぱい}→困憊：29849_konpai⟧ means exhaustion/being worn out. Together they emphasize extreme, total exhaustion.
Stronger than ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ (tired) or even ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧ (fatigue) alone. Implies being completely drained of energy. Somewhat literary but commonly used when describing extreme tiredness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of total exhaustion
- {疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be utterly exhausted
- {疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse from exhaustion
